blocks.text: Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that a man once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ to ask for transport. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "We shall give you the child of a camel to ride." "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" the man said in surprise, "What will I do with the child of a camel (it is too small to ride)?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Is every camel not the child of another?"[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Jokes with Hadhrat Anas (RA)
Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once jokingly called Hadhrat Anas (RA) saying, "O two-eared one!"[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Jokes with Hadhrat Zaahir (RA)

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that a man from the countryside called Zaahir (RA) used to give Rasulullaah ﷺ things from the countryside and when he left, Rasulullaah ﷺ would give him things from the city. Rasulullaah ﷺ used to say, "Zaahir is our countryside and we are his city." Although he was not a good looking person, Rasulullaah ﷺ liked him a lot. As he was busy selling his wares in the marketplace one day, Rasulullaah ﷺ grabbed him from the back (and covered his eyes) so that he could not see. "Release me!" Hadhrat Zaahir (RA) shouted, but when he turned and recognised Rasulullaah ﷺ, he started pressing his back closer to Rasulullaah ﷺ's chest. "Who will buy this slave?" Rasulullaah ﷺ announced. "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Zaahir (RA) said, "By Allaah! If you sell me, you will run at a loss." "Not at all," Rasulullaah ﷺ corrected, "You are not a loss in the sight of Allaah. In Allaah's sight, you are expensive."[^4]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Jokes with Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and his Other Wives (RA)

Hadhrat Nu'maan bin Basheer (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was once about to ask permission to enter Rasulullaah ﷺ's room, he heard (his daughter) Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) raising her voice at Rasulullaah ﷺ. When he entered, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) grabbed her to give her a slap saying, "Are you raising your voice above that of Allaah's Rasool ﷺ?!"
